caption_L1: This area plot is named Honda CBR1000RR registered motorcycle numbers in Great Britain from 2004 to 2018. There is a linear scale from 0 to 8,000 on the y-axis, labeled Number of registered motorcycles. The x-axis measures Year with a linear scale from 2004 to 2016.
caption_L2L3: Overall the number of registered motorcycles has increased from 2004 to 2018. In 2004, the number of registered motorcycles was at its lowest of below 2000. There has been a steep increase to just under 8000 registered motorcycles in 2009 which was the highest number on this chart. After 2009, there has been a steady decrease in the number of registered motorcycles to just below 6000 in 2018.
